data.name: Ghosty Is In Hell
data.detailed_description:
Ghosty is... in Hell?

Ghosty is in Hell is a fast-paced, retro-inspired action game about surviving waves of enemies in a hostile underworld.

You play as Ghosty, a tiny ghost thrown into hell with one goal: survive long enough to fight back.

Fight with Weapons That Change How You Play

Ghosty fights with weapons, and we have several!

Each weapon behaves differently and can drastically change how you approach combat:

  • Some deal low damage but improve secondary stats like luck

  • Others hit hard but fire slowly

  • Some favor crowd control, others precision

Choosing the right weapon isn’t just about damage — it’s about survival strategy.

A Retro Feel

Inspired by classic pre-rendered techniques, Ghosty is in Hell tries to catch the feel of the rare technique that you (and us) loves.

Built for Replayability

No two runs feel exactly the same.

Different weapons, enemy compositions, and moment-to-moment decisions ensure each attempt tells its own story — whether it ends in triumph or failure.

If you enjoy compact, replayable action games with a strong identity, Ghosty is in Hell is made for you.
